name: When should I consider getting a Website Audit for Google AI Overviews?
description: Consider an audit when online visibility is crucial, you're losing traffic to AI Overviews, or if competitors are already appearing in these features.

mainEntity.name: When should I consider getting a Website Audit for Google AI Overviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider this audit if your business relies on online visibility, especially if you're experiencing reduced organic traffic from search queries that could be answered by AI Overviews. It's particularly crucial if your competitors are already appearing in these features or if your industry involves complex topics that AI could summarize effectively. Proactively auditing your site ensures you adapt to evolving search landscapes, maintain competitive advantage, and capitalize on new opportunities to reach potential customers through AI-powered search experiences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider an audit when online visibility is crucial, you're losing traffic to AI Overviews, or if competitors are already appearing in these features.
